what: concept only: a cap for the stock LF-2 with the steel disc on a platform beside the axis
frame: C: cap frame, origin at the centre of the skirt underside, z up; seated, C = W + (0, 0, 6); metal at C z -6

stock_reference_drawn.source: 2in.com reference page: 2 mm OD, PEEK, 63 mm overall or custom, 1 mm gold pin; relief and pin from the LF-2-Bent90 photo

lift_note: the 2.44 N the magnet lifts now acts 24 mm off the magnet's axis: a 59 N mm peel moment on the disc. The P25/20 holds the disc over its 25 mm face; at a 0.09 mm gap at the far edge the pull is a third of contact, so measure the pick-off on the bench before anything else
